_about: The 36 minigames as weapons and spells (SPEC.md › Attacks and spells). gameId is the legacy game id. kind: attack | spell | area | versus. family drives affixes and region bias. stat is the governing stat; lever describes how each point above/below 3 bends the odds (implemented in packages/games/levers.js). topMult is what counts as a critical hit when reached. starter marks the shared starter kit; classStart names the class whose starting weapon it is. `goal` is the one-line pitch and `howTo` the phone-sized how-to-play shown on the item sheet, the fight menu and in the Rulebook.

items.name: Coin Blade
items.lever: win chance +2% a point
items.goal: Call it, then spin.
items.howTo: A coin on a wheel: tap SPIN and it lands heads or tails. Heads hits for 1× your stake; tails and the stake is gone. The simplest swing in the game — no choices, just nerve.

items.name: Wheel of Ruin
items.lever: a spin stopping one segment off yours slides onto it 8% a point
items.goal: One spin, seven segments.
items.howTo: Spin the big wheel: it stops on 1×, 2×, 3×, 5×, 10×, 20× or LOSE. Whatever multiplier it lands on is what the target takes, times your stake; LOSE costs you the stake. The big segments are small — most spins are 1× or 2×.

items.name: Roulette Storm
items.lever: one extra covered number per 2 points
items.goal: Pick a bet, spin, cover the room.
items.howTo: An Area item: everyone on the tile may bet. Choose RED/BLACK, ODD/EVEN, LOW/HIGH (pays 1:1), a dozen or a column (2:1), or tap a single number (35:1), then SPIN. The ball lands on one pocket; every bet that covers it pays.

items.name: Fuse Bomb
items.lever: the fuse burns 4% slower a point
items.goal: Light the fuse, cash out before it blows.
items.howTo: Tap LAUNCH and the multiplier starts climbing from 1×. Tap CASH OUT any time to lock the multiplier you see — or set an Auto cash-out first. If the fuse blows before you cash out, you lose the stake. The longer you wait, the bigger the hit and the bigger the risk.

items.name: Minefield
items.lever: one fewer mine per 2 points
items.goal: Clear safe squares, walk away in time.
items.howTo: A 5×5 grid hides a few mines. Tap squares: each safe one raises the multiplier. Tap Walk away to bank what you have. Hit a mine and the stake is gone. Your picks are hidden from the table until the round ends.

items.name: Ward
items.lever: blackjack pays +0.1x a point; double on any two cards at 6
items.goal: Beat the dealer without going over 21.
items.howTo: A healing spell. You see two cards and the dealer's up-card. HIT to take a card, STAND to stop, DOUBLE to double the stake for exactly one more card. Beat the dealer's total without busting past 21 to heal; a natural blackjack pays 1.5×. Bust or lose the hand and the stake is burned.

items.name: Twin Fang
items.lever: banker commission falls 1% a point; Tie pays more
items.goal: Player, Banker or Tie — then watch.
items.howTo: Pick a side before the deal: PLAYER (1:1), BANKER (0.97:1) or TIE (9:1). Two hands are dealt by the book, closest to 9 wins. Nothing to do after the bet — it's a pure read on the odds.

items.name: Rockslide
items.lever: pegs lean to the outer high slots 3% a point
items.goal: Drop the rock, hope it bounces wide.
items.howTo: Tap DROP and a chip falls through a field of pegs into one of the slots along the bottom. The edges pay huge (33×), the middle pays under 1×. Where it lands is where it lands.

items.name: Mend
items.lever: ties heal at 5; peek the next card's colour at 7
items.goal: Higher or lower, card after card.
items.howTo: A healing spell. One card shows. Call HIGHER or LOWER for the next; the multiplier grows with every right call (the unlikely call pays more). CASH OUT whenever you like to heal for the multiplier you have. One wrong call and the stake is gone.

items.name: Loaded Dice
items.lever: the exact-call window widens by 1 per 3 points
items.goal: Roll 1–100 against your own target.
items.howTo: Choose UNDER or OVER a number: the safer the call, the smaller the multiplier (under 95 pays 1.03×; under 25 pays 4×). Tap ROLL. If the roll is on your side of the target you hit for that multiplier; otherwise you lose the stake.

items.name: Jackpot Cannon
items.lever: wild symbols 5% more common a point
items.goal: Pull the lever, match the reels.
items.howTo: Tap PULL. Three reels spin; matching symbols pay by the paytable, with the jackpot symbol paying the most and wilds standing in for anything. No decisions — a pure swing.

items.name: Star Shower
items.lever: one free extra pick per 2 points
items.goal: Pick your stars, the sky draws ten.
items.howTo: Tap up to 10 numbers on the board (or Quick 5), then DRAW. Ten numbers are drawn; the more of yours that come up, the bigger the multiplier. Picking fewer numbers makes each hit worth more.

items.name: Chain Lightning
items.lever: the first miss of a streak is forgiven at 6
items.goal: Call the coin, ride the streak.
items.howTo: Call HEADS or TAILS; each right call roughly doubles the multiplier and you may CASH OUT after any of them. A wrong call ends the streak and takes the stake. Two in a row is already a strong hit — greed is the whole game.

items.name: Clash
items.lever: ties go to the higher Grit
items.goal: High card wins. Ties go to Grit.
items.howTo: A Versus item for duels: you and your opponent each turn one card, the higher card wins the round outright. Ties go to the higher Grit. Nothing to decide — the fastest fight on the table.

items.name: Dragon's Breath
items.lever: Tie pays +1x a point above 3
items.goal: Dragon or Tiger — one card each.
items.howTo: Bet DRAGON (1:1), TIGER (1:1) or TIE (13:1) before the deal. One card is dealt to each side; the higher card wins. A tie pays big but is rare.

items.name: Hound Snap
items.lever: raise multiplier +0.2 a point
items.goal: Will the third card fall between the first two?
items.howTo: Two cards are dealt. If a third card would fall between them you may RAISE (doubling the stake) or stand; the narrower the gap, the better the payout. Consecutive cards push; a pair pays 11:1 if the third matches.

items.name: Triple Dice
items.lever: a triple pays 10x instead of 3x at 6
items.goal: Pick a number, three dice roll.
items.howTo: Pick a number from 1 to 6. Three dice are rolled: you hit once for each die showing your number (1×, 2×, 3× — a triple pays extra at high Grit). None of them and you lose the stake.

items.name: Bone Cage
items.lever: Small and Big lose less of their edge each point; triples no longer kill them at 7
items.goal: Three dice, a board of bets.
items.howTo: Bet on the three-dice total: SMALL (4–10) or BIG (11–17) at even money, ODD/EVEN, an exact total (up to 68:1 for a 4 or 17), or ANY TRIPLE (33:1). Then roll. Triples beat Small and Big unless your Grit is high.

items.name: Lucky Seven
items.lever: a 7 is a push instead of a loss at 5
items.goal: Two dice: under, over or exactly 7.
items.howTo: Bet UNDER 7 or OVER 7 (1.3:1) or EXACTLY 7 (4.75:1), then roll two dice. The total decides it. At Grit 5 a rolled 7 pushes instead of losing on Under/Over.

items.name: Prism Spin
items.lever: one extra colour covered per 3 points
items.goal: Bet a colour, spin the prism.
items.howTo: Bet a colour — Red pays 1.1:1 and covers nearly half the wheel; Purple pays 23:1 and is a sliver — then spin. Luck lets you cover an extra colour.

items.name: Scratch Charm
items.lever: one free extra scratch per 2 points
items.goal: Scratch panels, match three.
items.howTo: A healing spell. Nine hidden panels: tap to scratch them one at a time, or Scratch all. Three matching symbols heal for that symbol's multiplier. Your scratches are hidden from the table.

items.name: Limbo Rope
items.lever: the named multiplier is reached 3% more often a point
items.goal: Name a multiplier, see if the rope holds.
items.howTo: Type or pick a target multiplier (1.5× is likely, 50× is a prayer), then GO. A number is drawn; if it reaches your target you hit for exactly that multiplier, otherwise the stake is gone.

items.name: Stampede
items.lever: your runner starts one length ahead a point
items.goal: Back a runner, watch the stampede.
items.howTo: An Area item: everyone on the tile may bet. Back one of six runners — favourites pay about 3×, the long shot pays 15× — then the race runs. Only the winner pays. Luck gives your runner a head start.

items.name: Siege Tower
items.lever: one extra safe tile per floor per 3 points
items.goal: Climb floor by floor, one door is safe.
items.howTo: Each floor shows three doors; one or two are safe. Tap a door: safe and you climb, the multiplier rising with every floor; CASH OUT between floors to bank it. Open the wrong door and you fall with the stake.

items.name: Road Run
items.lever: traffic 5% slower a point
items.goal: Cross the road one lane at a time.
items.howTo: Tap STEP to cross a lane; each lane raises the multiplier and the risk shown before you step. CASH OUT when you've had enough. Get hit and the stake is gone.

items.name: Pachinko Hail
items.lever: the centre pocket 4% wider a point
items.goal: Drop five balls, hope for the centre.
items.howTo: Tap Drop 5 balls. Each ball rattles down the pins into a pocket; the centre pocket pays most, the edges pay least, and the five results add up into one multiplier.

items.name: The Briefcase
items.lever: the banker's offers rise 5% a point
items.goal: Keep a case, take the banker's offer or open yours.
items.howTo: A healing spell. Pick one of ten cases to keep. Open the others a few at a time; between rounds the banker offers a buyout — take DEAL to heal for the offer, or NO DEAL and keep going. Open all the rest and you heal for whatever your case holds.

items.name: Dice Duel
items.lever: your bust threshold +1 per 3 points
items.goal: Higher or lower on the dice, cash out before you bust.
items.howTo: A Versus item for duels: a die shows; call HIGHER or LOWER for the next roll (the long call pays more). Right calls stack the multiplier; CASH OUT to lock it. A wrong call busts. Grit widens your bust threshold.

items.name: The Bus
items.lever: a wrong first call is free at 5
items.goal: Ride the bus: four calls in a row.
items.howTo: Red or black? Higher or lower? Inside or outside? Which suit? Four calls, each one multiplying the stake; GET OFF after any right call to keep what you have. A wrong call stops the bus and takes the stake. Your calls are hidden from the table.

items.name: Shell Game
items.lever: Luck for the picker (+4% a point), Nerve for the hider (-4% a point)
items.goal: Find the pea under one of three cups.
items.howTo: A Versus item: one player hides the pea, the other points at a cup. Find it and the picker hits; miss and the hider does. Luck helps the picker, Nerve helps the hider.

items.name: Hand of Fate
items.lever: jacks-or-better pays 2x at 5; a second draw at 7
items.goal: Hold the cards you like, draw the rest.
items.howTo: Five cards are dealt. Tap the ones to HOLD (or tap Suggest), then DRAW to replace the rest. Jacks-or-better pays, pairs upward through straights, flushes and a royal. Below a pair and the stake is gone.

items.name: Trident
items.lever: the ante bonus pays from one rank lower per 3 points
items.goal: Three cards: play or fold.
items.howTo: You see your three cards. PLAY (doubling the stake) to go against the dealer's three, or FOLD and lose only the ante. A straight or better also pays an ante bonus whatever the dealer holds.

items.name: Let It Ride
items.lever: a pair pays from 9s at 5; pull back a third time at 7
items.goal: Three bets riding — pull them back or let it ride.
items.howTo: Three cards and three bets. Before each of the two community cards is turned you may pull one bet back or LET IT RIDE. A pair of 10s or better pays on every bet still riding; anything less loses them.

items.name: Hold'em Duel
items.lever: see one flop card before calling at 6
items.goal: Hole cards, a flop, call or fold.
items.howTo: A Versus item for duels: two hole cards each, then the flop. CALL (2× the bet) to see the turn and river against your opponent's hand, or FOLD and lose only the ante. Best five-card hand wins the pot.

items.name: Bone Toss
items.lever: a come-out 12 is a push at 4; odds pay +5% a point
items.goal: Come-out roll, then make your point.
items.howTo: Tap ROLL. On the come-out, 7 or 11 wins, 2, 3 or 12 loses; any other total becomes your point. Keep rolling: make the point again before a 7 to hit, roll a 7 first and the stake is gone.

items.name: Twin Ward
items.lever: commission falls 1% a point; copies go to you at 6
items.goal: Split seven cards into a high hand and a low hand.
items.howTo: A healing spell. From seven cards tap two for the small hand (or tap House way), the rest make the big hand — the big hand must outrank the small. Win both against the dealer to heal (less the commission); win one and it pushes; lose both and the stake is burned.
